WITH linked_transactions AS (
  SELECT tr.ordertypedist
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
),
mix_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) as count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM linked_transactions) as share,
    1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ordertypedist) FROM linked_transactions) as avg_share
  FROM linked_transactions
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  ordertypedist as mix,
  count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_average_by
FROM mix_stats
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC
